dara: Quick sync re: HelixEdge co-sell POC. Partner wants a 10-day shared sandbox, partner-run proxy adapter (they host an auth proxy), telemetry to their Datadog account, and clarity on channel revenue split for a follow-on reserved commit. Also asked about partner-managed KMS and offline HSM options.
omar: Notes: partner-run proxy is OK if they use our edge-agent v2 and sign our adapter SLA. On-prem HSM still requires Redwood Private. For hosted we support BYOK via cross-account KMS and can accept imported keys into cloud KMS.
leah: Traffic profile: steady 40 rps, bursts to 350 rps for ~5m. Recommend dedicated 3x vGPU staging pool with autoscale to 6 and prefix caching. We'll enable tenant-level service keys scoped to their tenant.
ops-oncall: Telemetry: we'll create a cross-account Datadog integration role and a read-only S3 export. Ensure request masking for PII and default retention 60 days for the POC. Add a protective burst throttle: 300 req/min sustained, bursts to 800 short window.
billing-ops: For POC offer $2,000 trial credit. For conversion, propose reserved baseline 2 vGPUs/mo with a channel split template (15% to partner) for first quarter. Need avg token/hr to finalize.
legal: Partner requested escrow for adapter code; legal says we can sign a limited adapter escrow NDA and reference template. Also flagged export-control question in questionnaire.
dara: Can someone paste a tiny curl for them to smoke test routing and the expected response? We'll include it in the runbook.
omar: Paste this (replace <TOKEN>):
```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"probe","max_tokens":4}'\n```
Expected: {"status":"succeeded","output":"pong"}
dara: Scheduling 30-min enablement runbook Fri 11am PT: agenda: tenant provisioning, proxy adapter checklist, Datadog integration, quote + channel split, legal escrow path. Action items: omar  infra + adapter checklist, leah  cost/token calc and pool sizing, billing-ops  draft co-sell quote and channel split, legal  prepare adapter NDA template. ops-oncall: please create provisioning ticket.
ops-oncall: Created ticket POC-8801 assigned to omar.
dara: Thanks all  I'll send invites and attach the partner sec questionnaire answers. :white_check_mark:
